statement.zh: 布拉克（及相关查加尔巴扎尔工作）的眼庙及相关第四–第三千纪语境见 Mallowan 1947（Iraq 9）。北部「殖民」解读留假说栏。
statement.en: At Tell Brak (and related Chagar Bazar work), Eye Temple–related and other 4th–3rd millennium contexts are documented in Mallowan 1947 (Iraq 9). Northern “colony” readings stay in the hypothesis column.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: Eye Temple contexts first; colony not fact.
